中東局勢持續升溫，伊朗無人機攻擊美國盟友科威特，遭防空系統攔截後，墜落殘骸造成2名意大利人死亡、另有2人受傷。 死者受聘國防承包商 科威特國防部26日表示，防空系統攔截多架來自伊朗的無人機，但墜落的殘骸造成2名意大利人死亡，另有一名科威特人及一名巴基斯坦人受傷。意大利外交部證實，死者是受聘於國防承包商、負責雷達系統維護工作的防空技術人員。 伊朗外交部長阿拉格齊（Abbas Araghchi）隨後致電意大利外長塔亞尼（Antonio Tajani）慰問。意大利總理梅洛尼隨後也發文表示哀悼。

「沒有進行任何軍事行動」 然而伊朗武裝部隊發言人謝卡爾奇（Abolfazl Shekarchi）將軍否認伊朗對科威特發動了無人機襲擊。 根據伊朗官方通訊社伊通社報道，謝卡爾奇「斷然且徹底地」駁斥了科威特軍方關於伊朗軍隊襲擊科威特的說法。謝卡爾奇表示：「伊朗伊斯蘭共和國武裝部隊在該地區沒有進行任何軍事或進攻行動。」 文章授權轉載自《中天新聞網》， 按此查看原始文章

⚡🚨BREAKING: Iran has struck a vital site inside Kuwait with multiple drones, injuring four people, including two Italian military personnel, after Kuwaiti air defenses attempted to engage the incoming drones, per Kuwait’s Defense Ministry. The attack caused injuries and material damage at the targeted facility. The injured include one Kuwaiti, two Italian military personnel and one Pakistani national. Iranian officials have warned that any military base or facility used to launch attacks against Iran will be targeted, regardless of its location. #Iran #Kuwait — Iran Flash News (@FlashWireNews) November 26, 2026

Ho appreso nel corso dei lavori del Consiglio europeo la notizia della tragica morte dei due cittadini italiani nell’attacco avvenuto in Kuwait. Esprimo, a nome mio e del Governo, profondo cordoglio e rivolgo le più sentite condoglianze ai familiari delle vittime. La mia vicinanza va a tutte le persone coinvolte nell’attacco e alle loro famiglie. — Giorgia Meloni (@GiorgiaMeloni) November 26, 2026
